item.title: Claude Code Plugins: Install, Scope and Remove (2026)
item.description:
What is a Claude Code plugin?

A Claude Code plugin is a folder that bundles skills, subagents, hooks and MCP servers, so you can install them as one unit. Most plugins come from a marketplace, a catalog that lists plugins and where to get each one. The folder has a manifest at .claude-plugin/plugin.json that gives it a name and version.

Use a plugin when you want several of these pieces packaged together, with updates from the marketplace. A single skill or MCP server you can also set up on its own. For those, see Claude Code MCP and Claude Code skills.

item.title: Codex MCP: Add, Configure and Check Servers (2026)
item.description:
What is MCP in Codex CLI?

item.title: Claude Code MCP: Add, Scope and Remove Servers (2026)
item.description:
What is an MCP server in Claude Code?

MCP (Model Context Protocol) lets Claude Code use outside tools. An MCP server is a small program or remote service that offers tools, such as “search notes” or “save this fact”. Once you add a server, Claude can call its tools in any session that loads it. You set servers up with the claude mcp commands, not by editing settings by hand.

item.title: How to Install Claude Code (2026): macOS, Windows, Linux
item.description:
What is Claude Code?

Claude Code is Anthropic’s coding agent that runs in your terminal. It reads your project, edits files and runs commands. You install it once on your machine, then start it with claude in any project folder. Its memory comes from files such as CLAUDE.md and from optional add-ons.

How do you install Claude Code?

Open a terminal and run the command for your system. Anthropic’s native installer is the recommended route, and it keeps itself up to date.

item.title: 如何安装 Claude Code（2026）：macOS、Windows、Linux
item.description:
什么是 Claude Code？

Claude Code 是 Anthropic 的编程 agent，在终端里运行。它读取你的项目、编辑文件并运行命令。你在电脑上安装一次，然后在任何项目文件夹里运行 claude 启动它。它的记忆来自 CLAUDE.md 等文件，以及可选的插件。

如何安装 Claude Code？

打开终端，运行适合你系统的命令。Anthropic 推荐的是原生安装器，它会自己保持最新。

系统 命令 更新方式
macOS、Linux、WSL curl -fsSL https://claude.ai/install.sh | bash 自动，在后台进行
Windows PowerShell irm https://claude.ai/install.ps1 | iex 自动，在后台进行
Windows CMD curl -fsSL https://claude.ai/install.cmd -o install.cmd && install.cmd && del install.cmd 自动，在后台进行
Homebrew（macOS、Linux） brew install --cask claude-code 手动：brew upgrade claude-code
WinGet（Windows） winget install Anthropic.ClaudeCode 手动：winget upgrade Anthropic.ClaudeCode
npm（任何装有 Node.js 22+ 的系统） npm install -g @anthropic-ai/claude-code 手动：npm install -g @anthropic-ai/claude-code@latest

Anthropic 的安装文档还列出了 Debian、Ubuntu、Fedora、RHEL 和 Alpine 的 apt、dnf 和 apk 软件源。这些安装同样需要手动升级。npm 安装不要加 sudo。
